s.en: a very fast network logon cracker which supports many different services
s.es: fuerza bruta de credenciales contra muchos servicios (SSH, FTP, HTTP, RDP…)

syn: hydra ⏎ [[[-l LOGIN|-L FILE] [-p PASS|-P FILE|-x OPT -y]] | [-C FILE]] ⏎ [-e nsr] [-u] [-f|-F] [-M FILE] [-o FILE] [-b FORMAT] ⏎ [-t TASKS] [-T TASKS] [-w TIME] [-W TIME] [-m OPTIONS] [-s PORT] ⏎ [-c TIME] [-S] [-O] [-4|6] [-I] [-vV] [-d] ⏎ server service [OPTIONS]

p.es: Equipo o servicio: ssh://10.0.0.5, ftp://host o «host servicio».
p.en: Host or service: ssh://10.0.0.5, ftp://host or "host service".

o.en: A single login name to try.

o.es: Se detiene al encontrar la primera credencial válida.
o.en: Exit after the first found login/password pair.
Exit after the first found pair per host.

o.es: Prueba también contraseña vacía (n), igual al usuario (s) e invertida (r).
o.en: Try null password (n), login as pass (s), reversed login (r).

o.es: Recorre usuarios en el bucle interior (en vez de contraseñas).

generate passwords from min to max length. charset can contain 1 for numbers, a for lowcase and A for upcase characters. Any other character is added is put to the list. Example: 1:2:a1%. The generated passwords will be of length 1 to 2 and contain lowcase letters, numbers and/or percent signs and dots.
